propositions: A new advisor overlay must flag when a write-op parameter, guard, or required field changes on one adapter (lib/_lib_writes.py, CLI/_commands/, MCP/_mcp_writes.py) without sibling adapters being updated in lockstep.

The overlay must be glob-triggered on the three write-surface files (_commands/**, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) and inert on unrelated diffs, wired into round_a/round_b batches so the finder is actually dispatched.

The overlay is advisory (blocking_enabled: false, block_threshold: 0.95) with false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergence, adapter-bound non-caller-visible params, and internal-only refactors.

The reviewer prompt must enumerate the three write surfaces, instruct grep-based sibling checking, and carry exceptions for intentional divergence (e.g., force/reason surface audit normalization per blusterous-earthly-kitten ruling).

The base-reviewer catalog and OVERLAY_IDS registry must stay in lockstep via test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids; reviewers/index.json remains unchanged (overlays excluded from selection catalog).
Unit tests must assert overlay membership/routing, glob firing per adapter, round_a/round_b dispatch, threshold resolution (0.95, False), and drift gate (base catalog, index.json) passing.
